spec.name: Orange Kitchen Lemonade
spec.description: A tall, stepped glass of golden lemonade with a raised glass rim, chunky ice, a bent straw and a fresh lemon wheel. Pale aqua glass accents and ivory citrus pith keep the silhouette crisp and appetizing. Stands at y=0.

prompt: Orange SMP Kitchen cohesive premium Minecraft vanilla voxel art. Appetizing recognizable silhouette and deliberate connected pixel shading, material detail and highlights. No plain untextured cubes, random noise, letters or scenery. Use ONE well-mapped 64x64 atlas; per-face UV islands, not repeated generic material tiles. Keep texture palette cohesive: warm golden bread, fresh greens, ivory rice, rich salmon, warm ceramics. Geometry should be carefully stepped and rounded where appropriate, with purposeful tiny details. 20-55 cuboids as appropriate, stay within Java model bounds -16..32. Item ground bottom y0. Strong inventory readability. Create Lemonade. Tall stepped glass or paper milkshake cup, appropriate drink color, straw and whipped cream if the recipe calls for cream. Actual recipe ingredients: lemon, sugar, water bottle. Let the visible appearance reflect these ingredients.
